cards.name: Baron Klaus Richter
cards.blurb: Menjual wolfram ke siapa pun yang membayar paling tinggi, dan selalu membayar tagihan hotelnya tunai.
cards.blurbEn: Sells wolfram to whoever pays most, and always settles his hotel bill in cash.

cards.name: Madame Odette Lavigne
cards.blurb: Lagunya berubah setiap malam; para perwira bersumpah liriknya berisi tanggal dan nama kapal.
cards.blurbEn: Her songs change every night; officers swear the lyrics carry dates and ship names.

cards.name: Kapten Henry Ashford
cards.blurb: Terlalu sering terlihat di dermaga untuk ukuran pria yang mengaku tidak suka laut.
cards.blurbEn: Seen at the docks far too often for a man who claims to dislike the sea.

cards.name: Signora Lucia Bellini
cards.blurb: Kantong diplomatiknya tak pernah diperiksa, dan ia tahu persis betapa berharganya hal itu.
cards.blurbEn: Her diplomatic pouch is never searched, and she knows exactly how valuable that is.

cards.name: Dr. Tomás Ferreira
cards.blurb: Merawat agen dari semua pihak tanpa bertanya, tapi mencatat setiap luka di buku kecilnya.
cards.blurbEn: Treats agents of every side without questions, yet notes every wound in a small book.

cards.name: Nikolai Orlov
cards.blurb: Berita yang ia kirim selalu tiba sehari sebelum kejadiannya.
cards.blurbEn: The news he files always arrives a day before it happens.

cards.name: Pelabuhan
cards.blurb: Gudang, derek, dan kapal netral yang berangkat tanpa jadwal.
cards.blurbEn: Warehouses, cranes and neutral ships that sail without a schedule.

cards.name: Alfama
cards.blurb: Labirin gang sempit di bawah benteng; mudah menghilang di sini.
cards.blurbEn: A maze of narrow alleys beneath the castle; easy to vanish here.

cards.name: Baixa
cards.blurb: Pusat dagang berpetak rapi tempat uang dan rahasia berpindah tangan.
cards.blurbEn: A tidy grid of commerce where money and secrets change hands.

cards.name: Chiado
cards.blurb: Kafe dan toko buku tempat para penulis dan informan berbagi meja.
cards.blurbEn: Cafés and bookshops where writers and informants share tables.

cards.name: Avenida
cards.blurb: Boulevard megah, hotel mewah, dan lobi penuh telinga.
cards.blurbEn: A grand boulevard, luxury hotels and lobbies full of ears.

cards.name: Estoril
cards.blurb: Kasino, vila bangsawan buangan, dan pantai yang diawasi teropong.
cards.blurbEn: A casino, exiled nobles' villas and a beach watched through binoculars.

cards.name: Mikrofilm
cards.blurb: Seluruh rencana muat dalam satu titik sebesar huruf.
cards.blurbEn: The whole plan fits on a dot the size of a letter.

cards.name: Rotor Mesin Sandi
cards.blurb: Tanpanya, pesan musuh hanyalah huruf acak.
cards.blurbEn: Without it, enemy traffic is just random letters.

cards.name: Peta Pantai Pendaratan
cards.blurb: Garis pasang surut dan posisi meriam, digambar tangan.
cards.blurbEn: Tide lines and gun positions, drawn by hand.

cards.name: Buku Kode
cards.blurb: Sampul kulit, halaman yang direndam agar cepat larut dalam air.
cards.blurbEn: Leather cover, pages treated to dissolve in water.

cards.name: Daftar Nama Agen
cards.blurb: Satu lembar kertas yang bisa menghabisi seluruh jaringan.
cards.blurbEn: One sheet of paper that could end an entire network.

cards.name: Foto Udara
cards.blurb: Diambil dari ketinggian dua belas ribu kaki pada pagi yang cerah.
cards.blurbEn: Taken from twelve thousand feet on a clear morning.
